mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_plc_write_log (user_id, page_name, tag_name, address, value) VALUES (#{userId}, #{pageName}, #{tagName}, #{address}, #{value})
mapper.select: SELECT log_id AS logId, user_id AS userId, page_name AS pageName, tag_name AS tagName, address AS address, value AS value, DATE_FORMAT(written_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS writtenAt FROM tb_plc_write_log WHERE written_at BETWEEN #{sdateTime} AND #{edateTime} ORDER BY written_at DESC
